body: Let's say I have a workflow with 100 calls to the same activity. I want each activity to have a custom name so that when I look at the event history diagram, I can quickly identify what call it corresponds to. Is this possible? Right now, it only displays the activity function name.

comments.body:
This feature is now supported via the **user metadata** capability that has been added to both the server and SDKs.

You can now add a custom summary/label to activities that will appear in the UI Event History diagram:

**Go SDK:**
```go
ctx = workflow.WithActivityOptions(ctx, workflow.ActivityOptions{
    StartToCloseTimeout: time.Minute,
    Summary: "Process Order #12345",  // This will appear in the UI
})
workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, MyActivity, input)
```

**Python SDK:**
```python
await workflow.execute_activity(
    my_activity,
    input,
    start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=1),
    summary="Process Order #12345",  # This will appear in the UI
)
```

This same capability is also available for:
- Timers (`TimerOptions.Summary`)
- Child workflows (`ChildWorkflowOptions.StaticSummary`)
- Side effects (`SideEffectOptions.Summary`)
- And other workflow constructs

This issue can likely be closed as the requested functionality is now available.

title: Is it possible to dynamially customize what labels are shown for activities in the Event History diagram?
